name: SANDJEST Nutrition Facts Nurse Tumbler with Straw, 40 oz
seoTitle: Nutrition Facts Nurse Tumbler with Straw, 40 oz
metaDescription: A 40 oz nutrition facts nurse tumbler with handle and straw for big sips on busy shifts. A funny appreciation gift for nursing friends and coworkers.
summary: A nutrition facts style nurse tumbler with a handle and straw. A funny, useful appreciation gift for the nursing friend who never leaves home without a big drink.
whyItWorks: The joke works because it is true. A nutrition facts label for a nurse lists the stuff that really fuels a shift, and nurses tend to recognize themselves in it right away. Pairing that humor with a large insulated tumbler means the gift is more than a laugh. She can fill it with ice water before handoff and keep it at her side until she finally sits down to chart hours later.

Straw tumblers have become the go to cup for a lot of nurses, since a quick sip through a straw is faster than twisting off a lid between patients. The handle helps when her hands are already full walking in from the parking garage. It suits a birthday, Christmas, or Nurses Week gift between friends, and it is easy to give as a set to a few coworkers who share the same sense of humor.
